headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of July 22, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 18.52% compared to SPY's 10.46%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 8.06%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved a remarkable return of 48.59%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' still shows a positive return of 11.51%, reflecting resilience in the portfolio set. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
